NONSPECIFIC INTERSTITIAL PNEUMONIA (NSIP) — MUST KNOWS- Chronic bilateral ILD; unknown etiology

qs.q: A patient is evaluated for chronic cough and dyspnea. High-resolution CT shows lower lobe fibrosis and sparing of costophrenic angles, characteristic of nonspecific interstitial pneumonia. Which autoimmune disease is frequently associated?
qs.e: Systemic sclerosis frequently involves pulmonary manifestations, including nonspecific interstitial pneumonia and pulmonary fibrosis.
